summary: AB Private Lending Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of Class I common shares (4,045 shares for $100,000.77) under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, monthly distribution declarations ($0.20 per Class I share) and April 30, 2026 NAV per share ($24.72). The filing also updates the ongoing $1.0B continuous public offering. No merger, tender, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The content is standard operational and disclosure reporting for a business development company.
